decisions.statement: A build still processing is answered rather than refused.
A build that failed or is invalid is refused.
A wait running out is refused rather than answered as still processing.
A token is minted for each read rather than held across a wait.
An app no build has been uploaded for is answered rather than refused.
Nothing here builds or uploads or reaches the mac.

definition: the command saying how far App Store Connect has got with the newest build
